title: Cord pH EMR
description: Clinical database capturing birth events and early neonatal care at a maternity/neonatal hospital, centered on umbilical cord blood gas results and outcomes for babies at risk of hypoxic-ischaemic injury. The primary entities are the baby (and linked mother) and the birth encounter; cord_ph_birth_records holds the structured intrapartum/delivery dataset and nicu_admissions holds the neonatal unit course, while encounters, conditions, procedures, medications, devices and observations carry the standard EMR longitudinal record. Patients, providers, organizations and payers give demographics, staffing and billing context. Free-text narrative lives in clinical_notes.text (birth summaries, NICU admission and progress notes); short free-text also appears in maternal_comorbidities_other, sentinel_event_detail, mri_injury and the data_quality_flag fields.
